clarification_questions.question: For each stream, how far is the measurement point from where an analyzer could stand?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: Which probe geometry or interface is used (At the process, short cable: adds MIR ATR probe to the shortlist; drops NIR diffuse reflection probe from the shortlist; In the next room: adds risk: a long fiber link; Far away, long cable run: adds risk: a long fiber link)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The link length limits which fibers and methods remain practical.

clarification_questions.question: Do you already have numerical acceptance criteria, such as required accuracy or detection limits, for each stream?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Yes, they are defined: plan: test against the agreed criteria; Not yet: plan: agree numerical criteria before the test)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: Without them the experiment has no go or no-go criterion.

clarification_questions.question: Over what range must each relevant target variable be monitored in each stream?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Narrow, around a set point: plan: sample around the set point; Wide, from low to high: plan: sample the full range)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The range decides whether the sensitivity of a method can be enough.

clarification_questions.question: How quickly must a result be available for each stream?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Real time, within seconds: plan: a short link and fast sampling; Hours are fine: plan: at-line sampling may be enough)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The response time limits the measurement and sampling set-up.

rationale.text: NIR transmission is preferred for transparent or semi-transparent liquids such as whey.

conditions.text: Quantitative NIR analysis may need chemometric calibration because its absorption bands overlap.

rationale.text: In-line NIR reflection is used for opaque or highly concentrated dairy products, including milk concentrates.

limitations.text: NIR reflection is sensitive to surface characteristics and fat globule size.

rationale.text: NIR diffuse-reflection probes are suited to scattering media.

conditions.text: Retain this option for whey only if the sample comparison demonstrates a usable diffuse-reflection signal.

rationale.text: A transflection probe can sometimes serve both low-fat and high-fat milk products.

conditions.text: Retain this option for the concentrate only if sample tests demonstrate usable transmission or transflection spectra.

limitations.text: Transmission fails when milk becomes too thick or fat-rich for light to penetrate.

samples_and_states.text: Collect representative whey and milk-concentrate samples across the client-agreed composition ranges and relevant physical states.

reference_measurements.text: Pair spectra with time-aligned laboratory protein and fat results wherever those variables are relevant.

setup.text: Acquire NIR spectra with the candidate interfaces on matched samples under controlled conditions before testing realistic process conditions.

comparison.text: Compare interface-specific chemometric models within each stream for composition error, bias and sensitivity to physical-state changes.

validation.text: Validate each model against laboratory results on independent production material excluded from model fitting and selection.

go_no_go.text: Proceed only if validation meets the acceptance criteria agreed before testing and the tested interface suits the intended installation.

not_demonstrated.text: Performance for untested compositions, physical states or installation conditions remains unknown.

steps: Clarify ranges, acceptance criteria and installation constraints.
Collect representative samples across agreed compositions and physical states.
Obtain time-aligned laboratory references for relevant variables.
Set up interfaces and compare spectra and models within each stream.
Decide go or no-go against pre-agreed criteria.

decision_basis.text: Base the interface decision for each stream on comparison with laboratory references on independent material against criteria agreed with the client before testing.
